name: Coordinate-state denoising v1: paired A rectified flow / B displacement EDM
priority: User high-priority branch; unfinished CM4 worktree is parked, not trained or merged
code_parent: 7c2c0f9; reuse shallow modules and evaluators, not CF1 trained weights
status: Both recipes, shared network, objectives, full samplers and trainer implemented. TRAIN scale statistics complete; CUDA checks/training not yet run. No efficacy or superiority claim.

paired_budget.initialization: Random initialization, no pretrained representations or generative weights; identical architecture and initialization RNG per paired seed
paired_budget.history: H4/H8 alternate by system visits; Q12/Q8 are all remaining futures, not one-frame training
paired_budget.future_frame_exposure: A/B identical within each seed; log actual target_frames and atom_query_pairs
paired_budget.sampling: 18 intervals,35 network calls per complete joint window in both arms; Heun except final Euler endpoint
paired_budget.resource_scope: Use two already-authorized local GPU lanes only when their current owners and queued predecessor work finish; no cancellation or sharing of busy GPUs
paired_budget.fairness: Matched A/B architecture, data sequence, random initialization, optimizer schedule, updates and NFE. Actual wallclock/FLOPs may differ because noise changes neighbor graphs. Historical h/v and external references are not matched-training-budget causal controls.

TRAIN_statistics.definition: Square root of equal-system mean per-coordinate second moment of future minus last observation, using six TRAIN visits/system covering histories and native clocks
TRAIN_statistics.limitation: Per-coordinate moment approximation only; individual atom tails are not uniformly negligible, and high-dimensional distribution closeness is unproven. No validation-derived scales.
TRAIN_statistics.failed_first_attempt: AttributeError reading nonexistent ClipBatch.atoms before scoring first record; repaired to x.shape[1]. Failed directory/log retained; only v2 completed statistics define both recipes.

A.loss: Equal-system valid atom/frame coordinate MSE(u,Y-R)/sigma_data^2; the common constant normalization does not change the target or optimum
A.sampling: Deterministic rectified-flow ODE from independently drawn R over s0->1, Heun with last Euler. No Brownian bridge, stochastic bridge matching, extra SDE noise, projection or displacement clipping.

B.training: deltaY=Y-X_ref; sigma log-uniform over frozen TRAIN bounds; Z=deltaY+sigma*epsilon
B.c_in: 1/sqrt(sigma^2+sigma_data^2), applied to the displacement stem, while geometry receives current physical XYZ
B.output: D=c_skip*Z+c_out*F_theta; clean displacement, not next noisy state
B.sampling: Z=sigma_max*epsilon; power7 EDM grid sigma_max->sigma_min->0; ODE direction(Z-D)/sigma; Heun at positive endpoints; final zero-noise endpoint assigned D directly; no sigma0 network call, churn or guidance
B.not_claimed: This is EDM-style molecular displacement modeling, not AF3 reproduction or a claim that diffusion must outperform flow.

modules: global chemical-unit scalar/vector attention and atom lift
shared_architecture.geometry: Current radius neighbors rebuilt on every evaluation, union all covalent bonds. Bonded edges retain their actual noisy distances and directions but are exempt from the distance cutoff envelope. No target-defined graph or permanent initial-contact constraint.
shared_architecture.static_support: Shared geometry, interactions and head; static singleton receives only corrupted coordinates as condition. No static updates have run and no static pretraining benefit is claimed.
shared_architecture.weight_inheritance: None. No frozen teacher, future h/v target, latent adapter or latent normalization statistics in the generative path.
shared_architecture.limitations: This initial prototype has a different trunk from historical h/v generation. Gains over that baseline alone cannot isolate state representation from architecture, training exposure or pretraining.

baseline_and_evaluation.protocol: Same cached full atom sets, observed H4 and12query windows; protein48 two anchors/two draws at100/80/1000ps; complex64 two anchors/eight draws at80ps; fixed-final models only. Preserve PVB/BioKinema native-input differences and training-overlap disclosures.
baseline_and_evaluation.unseen_system_check: Selected128protein and128complex TRAIN IDs have empty intersection with development48protein and64complex IDs; metadata-only check. Not a new independent family/scaffold or pretraining-clean test claim.
